advisory_headline.tr: Kuveyt genelinde güvenlik seviyesi çok yüksektir; alkolün kesinlikle yasak olduğu (tamamen kuru ülke) unutulmamalıdır.
advisory_headline.en: Kuwait is very safe; strict total prohibition of alcohol applies nationwide with severe legal penalties.
advisory_headline.de: Kuwait ist sehr sicher; landesweit gilt ein striktes absolutes Alkoholverbot mit harten Strafen.
advisory_headline.ru: В Кувейте высокий уровень безопасности; действует строгий сухой закон (полный запрет алкоголя).
advisory_headline.es: Kuwait es muy seguro; rige una prohibición estricta y absoluta del alcohol en todo el país.

us.conditions: US citizens can obtain a 90-day tourist visa on arrival at Kuwait International Airport or online via eVisa.

de.conditions: German and EU citizens are eligible for a 90-day tourist visa on arrival or electronic visa prior to travel.

gb.conditions: British passport holders can obtain a 90-day tourist visa on arrival at the airport or apply online for an eVisa.

ru.conditions: Граждане РФ могут получить туристическую визу по прибытии в аэропорту Кувейта или оформить электронную визу (eVisa).

dos.title: Respect the strict total alcohol ban
dos.description: Kuwait is 100% dry; importing, selling, possessing, or consuming alcohol is strictly criminalized with severe prison sentences.

dos.title: Dress modestly in public places and malls
dos.description: Both men and women should dress conservatively (covering shoulders and knees) when visiting shopping complexes like The Avenues.

dos.title: Visit the iconic Kuwait Towers
dos.description: Take the high-speed lift to the revolving viewing sphere 123 meters above sea level for panoramic views of the Arabian Gulf.

donts.title: Don't bring pork or alcohol in your luggage
donts.description: Customs baggage X-rays at Kuwait Airport inspect all incoming bags; illicit items are confiscated with criminal penalties.

donts.title: Don't photograph government palaces or oil installations
donts.description: Strict photography bans exist around state ministries, refinery facilities, and royal palaces (Bayan Palace).

etiquette.tipping: Tipping 10-15% in sit-down restaurants is customary; hotel bills often include a service charge.
